# gigahost_dns_zone_ds_records (Resource)

Submits DS records to the registry for a domain registered with Gigahost but served by external nameservers. The configured set replaces all DS records at the registry. The API has no endpoint to read external DS records back, so drift is not detected. Destroying the resource disables DNSSEC for the domain, which removes the DS records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone_ds_records" "example" {
  zone_id = gigahost_dns_zone.example.zone_id

  ds_records = [
    {
      key_tag     = 12345
      algorithm   = 13
      digest_type = 2
      digest      = "1234567890ABCDEF1234567890ABCDEF1234567890ABCDEF1234567890ABCDEF"
    },
  ]

  depends_on = [gigahost_dns_zone_dnssec.example]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ds_records` (Attributes Set) DS records to submit to the registry. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `zone_id` (String) Id of the DNS zone (registered domain).

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Required:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC algorithm number. Valid values are `5`, `7`, `8`, `10`, `13`, `14`, `15` and `16`.
- `digest` (String) Hexadecimal digest. Its length must match the digest type.
- `digest_type` (Number) Digest type: `1` (SHA-1), `2` (SHA-256) or `4` (SHA-384). International TLDs accept only `1` and `2`.
- `key_tag` (Number) Key tag (0-65535).

Optional:

- `key_type` (Number) DNSKEY flags: `257` (KSK) or `256` (ZSK). Defaults to `257`.
- `public_key` (String) Base64 DNSKEY public key. Required by some registries (for example `.be`, `.ch`, `.cz`, `.de`, `.ee`, `.eu`, `.li` and `.nl`).
